papers.title: MACaQ: Fast, Model Agnostic Calibrated Quantization for Low-Precision Weights and Activations
papers.desc: Weight-activation quantization can reduce the memory and compute cost of neural-network inference, but recent methods often require expensive optimization and architecture-specific propagation of basis transforms across layers.

papers.title: Embodied First Exam
papers.desc: Early successes on agentic robotics point to a potential paradigm shift toward using coding agents to control robots.

papers.title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Deleting Weights in LLM Post-Training
papers.desc: How little of a pretrained large language model (LLM) has to change for it to acquire new capabilities? We find that zeroing fewer than 0.05% of its weights, with no other modification, matches full fine-tuning (FFT) at scale across three LLM post-training regimes: reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, supervised fine-tuning, and on-policy distillation.

papers.title: PhyRubric: Rubric-Grounded Diagnostic Evaluation of Physical Commonsense in Text-to-Video Generation
papers.desc: As text-to-video (T2V) models are increasingly positioned as world simulators, it is essential to evaluate whether their videos conform to physical commonsense.

papers.title: From Tool State to Scientific Action: Auditing Decision Provenance in Biomedical Research Agents
papers.desc: A scientific agent can give the same verdict while reading and citing different evidence.

papers.title: Micius-Flash: Lightweight Agentic Intelligence for Engineering
papers.desc: We introduce Micius-Flash, a 27-billion-parameter model for engineering with native multimodal input, deep reasoning and a 256K-token context window.

papers.title: Test-Time Scaling for Diffusion Language Models with Frequency-Aware Remasking
papers.desc: Diffusion language models (DLMs) generate text through iterative denoising, where decisions about which tokens to commit or remask strongly affect output quality.

papers.title: LEASH: Stay Safe in Agentic Robotics
papers.desc: Foundation models such as GPT and Claude have shown strong capabilities in spatial understanding and embodied intelligence.

papers.title: DyCraft: An Agentic System for Long-Horizon 4D Scene Generation
papers.desc: While frontier coding agents can generate high-quality 3D scenes and articulated assets, they struggle to create coherent long-horizon animations.

papers.title: Blind Variation, Selective Retention: Improving Creative Idea Generation in AI Scientists
papers.desc: Scientific discovery requires ideas that are original, useful, and non-obvious.

papers.title: Are Causal Neuron Circuits Unique and Transferable?
papers.desc: Interpretability demonstrations often show that intervening on a group of neurons changes a model's answer.

papers.title: Sable: A Small-Field Sumcheck Argument for Bit-Exact Inference of Large Language Models
papers.desc: We present Sable, an argument system and single-GPU prover for the statement that a committed, integer-quantized transformer produced a given token sequence from a given prompt, bit for bit.

papers.title: TorchCurves: Differentiable Parametric Curves
papers.desc: We present TorchCurves, a PyTorch library that treats vector-valued parametric curves as learnable primitives.

papers.title: Visual Similarity in Adult Word Extension and Artificial Word Learning
papers.desc: When two objects share a name, how much does their visual similarity explain, and what do the teaching examples add? First, we reanalyzed trial-level data from a large adult word-extension study (Lewis & Frank, 2018), computing each test image's distance to the examples shown in the space of a frozen self-supervised visual encoder (DINOv2).

papers.title: Prompt2Echo (P2Echo): Text-Prompted Multi-View Echocardiography Segmentation with One Model
papers.desc: Automated segmentation in multi-view echocardiography is essential for comprehensive cardiac assessment, yet remains challenging due to substantial anatomical and appearance variability across standard acoustic windows.
